seoGuide.title: How buyers compare popular ice machine types
seoGuide.subtitle: A quick guide for visitors comparing cube ice makers, portable units, and low-power daily-use machines.
seoGuide.intro: When people compare ice machines, they usually look at ice shape, daily output, energy usage, and whether the machine is compact enough for kitchens, pantries, or small beverage counters.

items.title: Cube ice and crystal-style ice makers
items.body: Buyers often search for ice machines that produce clean cube-style ice for drinks, small shops, and home use. The practical decision usually comes down to output, size, and maintenance.

items.title: Portable machines for lighter usage
items.body: Portable ice makers are useful for homes, offices, and small counters that need flexible placement and quick access to daily ice production.

items.title: 12kg and low-power models
items.body: A 12kg portable ice maker is a strong fit for lighter demand, especially when buyers also care about lower power consumption and easier setup.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions buyers usually ask before choosing a Soocool machine.

items.question: How do I choose the right ice machine capacity?
items.answer: Choose based on daily demand, installation space, and the type of business you run. Home and office users usually need smaller models, while cafes, restaurants, and markets should focus on larger commercial output.

items.question: What do buyers usually mean by cube ice, crystal ice, or portable ice maker?
items.answer: These terms often describe compact machines that make drink-ready cube-style ice. In practice, output, energy use, and placement flexibility matter more than the exact search phrase.

items.question: Do you provide installation and after-sales support?
items.answer: Yes. Soocool supports customers with consultation, installation guidance, and after-sales service so the machine can keep running reliably in daily use.

items.question: Can I ask for a recommendation before buying?
items.answer: Yes. You can contact the team on WhatsApp, describe your usage scenario, and get a recommendation based on your required output, storage, and operating environment.
